players.product: Optical fiber preform (PCVD and VAD/OVD), single-mode and multimode fiber and cable for telecom and AI data centers (G.654.E, polarization-maintaining, multi-core, hollow-core fiber, high-fiber-count ribbon cable); optical interconnect components (optical modules, AOCs, MPO / MMC connectors, FAUs)

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record, 2026 half-year results briefing on 2026-09-24): capital spending on computing-power data centers at home and abroad remains strong, fiber demand keeps rising and the industry is in an up-cycle; computing data centers' demand for new-type fiber has become the industry's most important driver, moving the global fiber and cable market from 'telecom as the single pillar' to 'telecom and datacom dual drivers'; the domestic telecom market is developing steadily while demand for AI new-type fiber and cable for computing data centers keeps growing fast.

Management (IR record): the industry's supply-demand structure is healthy, but the new-type preforms and fiber products needed by computing data centers are still in some shortage; capacity utilization of the main products is at a high level (no rate disclosed), the overseas bases included; the company has business in silicon tetrachloride and germanium tetrachloride preform raw materials, and raw-material supply and cost structure are relatively stable.

Management (IR record): H1 2026 gross margin was 53.4% versus 28.3% in H1 2025, mainly from demand growth and higher average product prices, a rising share of more profitable AI new-type fiber and cable products, and a relatively stable main-business cost structure; H1 2026 operating cash flow was about RMB 18.3 hundred million, up about 116.8% year on year. The company issues no earnings forecast.
quarterly_data.figure: gross margin 53.4% (H1 2025: 28.3%); operating cash flow about RMB 18.3 hundred million (+116.8%)

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): in September 2026, at the 2026 China Computing Power Conference, YOFC announced anti-resonant hollow-core fiber attenuation of 0.032dB/km (company: a new global record for lowest transmission loss); it has built a complete hollow-core chain from preform making through drawing and coating to cabling and testing, completed applications with China's three major operators in metro, intelligent-computing interconnect and ocean transmission, and set records including the longest commercial line of 100 km. Management: faster hollow-core commercialization depends on further solution maturity and customer acceptance.
